summary.text: Paul Pate is Iowa's Republican Secretary of State, seeking another term. He previously held the office from 1995 to 1999 and again since 2015, and also served as a state senator and as a mayor.

paragraphs.text: Earned an associate degree from Kirkwood Community College (1978); third-generation owner of his family's asphalt business.
Iowa Secretary of State 1995-1999 and since 2015; says in his survey that he served as a state senator and as a mayor.
